title: ArEEG: Arabic Inner Speech EEG dataset
description: ArEEG is an open-access EEG dataset of inner speech recorded from 12 participants (7 males, 5 females) who were shown visual cues written in Modern Standard Arabic. It comprises 186 continuous recordings from 8 scalp electrodes (Fz, C3, Cz, C4, Pz, PO7, Oz, PO8) sampled at 250 Hz. The dataset supports research on Arabic inner speech decoding and brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: Continuous BrainVision EEG was recorded at 250 Hz from 8 scalp channels placed per the 10-10 system while participants silently produced inner speech in response to visual cues written in Modern Standard Arabic.
